patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Bombora share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than Bombora's shape. Choose Bombora only if your buying job matches “Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact dat” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans contact-management; Bombora leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Bombora share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; Bombora is Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact database; custom-quote packaging..
- Company-size focus: Adapt.io (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Bombora (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning contact-management vs Bombora-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; Bombora — Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database.

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; Bombora: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Custom-quote only via speak-to-an-expert path.

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · Bombora is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need Bombora's motion (Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a c)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
